expectations.text: Proposes a specific, named feature/integration branch (not main) as where lane PRs merge, without the user having asked for one
expectations.evidence: "Integration branch | `feature/issue-300`, created off `origin/main`. I picked the name ... Not `main`." The user's prompt named no branch.

expectations.text: Proposes auto-merge into that branch on review pass + green CI
expectations.evidence: "Merge authority | `auto` into `feature/issue-300`"; recommended option: "Lane PRs then get real checks, and I merge on review pass plus green." Merge-on-review-alone is offered only as an explicit user choice.

expectations.text: Keeps the merge into main for the user (a landing PR or equivalent), not merged by the orchestrator
expectations.evidence: "Landing | One PR, `feature/issue-300` into `main`, as a merge commit. You merge it." and "I don't merge it. You do".

expectations.text: Flags that the CI workflow's `branches: [main]` trigger means PRs into the feature branch get no checks
expectations.evidence: "The CI workflow triggers on `pull_request:` with `branches: [main]`. Lane PRs will target a feature branch, so no checks will run on them at all. 'No checks reported' there means nothing ran, not that the PR is green."

expectations.text: Plans to close issues manually after each merge because Closes #N does not fire off the default branch
expectations.evidence: "`Closes #n` doesn't fire off the default branch. After every merge I close the issue myself with a comment naming the PR, then re-query the graph." Step 8 shows view, close, confirm CLOSED.

expectations.text: Asks for one confirmation of the contract, not a series of separate questions
expectations.evidence: A single reply is requested: "Reply with one typed sentence" with two alternatives; "If your answer changes a row, I'll take it as the yes for the rest". No sequence of questions.

expectations.text: Does not let a plain yes mean merging lane PRs with no CI: makes the user choose how the missing checks are handled before any merge
expectations.evidence: "`auto` would mean merging on review alone, and a plain yes doesn't grant that." "A bare 'yes' approves everything except the CI choice ... hold the merges with the PRs left ready until you pick." Two options offered (widen triggers, or trailing CI).

expectations.text: Asks for the confirmation as a typed sentence naming the merge grant (e.g. 'merge on green into <branch>')
expectations.evidence: "Reply with one typed sentence: `merge on green into feature/issue-300, I'll widen the triggers`, or `merge on review pass into feature/issue-300, trailing CI`".
